pageHeader.title: What I Offer
pageHeader.intro:
Our wellness salon offers more than hair styling — we are focused on bringing wholeness to our clients through self-reflection. Our salon offers an environment for clients to enjoy, relax, and be present. We cultivate a safe space for self-care, self-expression, and positive change. I believe the beauty and wellness experience should leave you with more than a service you love — it should leave you feeling uplifted, confident, and reconnected to the best version of yourself.

With over a decade of experience as a Texas certified cosmetologist, I bring a thoughtful balance of technical precision and intuitive artistry to every appointment. As a practicing tarot consultant and astrological chart interpreter, I offer one-on-one guidance and care in my home studio. Here at Pink Moon we offer a diverse range of self-care through creating looks, intuitive guidance, and sensory touch services.

categories.name: Haircuts & Styling
categories.description: All haircut prices begin for the first hour — price goes up an additional $25 every extra hour. All haircut consultations are complimentary and up to fifteen minutes. Please note: Blow Dry services are a separate additional charge.

services.name: Long Hair Cut
services.description: Hair length beginning past the shoulders and down, finished with a style.

services.name: Short Hair Cut
services.description: Hair length above the shoulders and up, finished with a style.

services.name: Clipper / Cut Combo
services.description: Clippers on the sides with scissor cutting and thinning on top.

services.name: Blow Dry Style
services.description: A simple blow dry to remove frizz and seal in products and treatments.

categories.name: Revitalizing Hair Services
categories.description: Our revitalizing haircuts are done with spiritual intention to help boost and heal different moods. These services include all standard hair products and treatments plus a Reiki reading on head and shoulders, crystal work, and a single oracle card reading.

services.name: Cleansing Trim
services.description: Maintenance, strengthening, and centering. Trimming layers optional.

services.name: Phoenix Cut
services.description: Creating a new style or refreshing an old one. Great for removing bulk with thinning and layering — perfect for manifesting goals. Layers optional.

services.name: Pixies & Buzzcuts
services.description: Short haircuts that expose the neck — clippers and non-clippers welcome.

services.name: Smoothing Blow Dry
services.description: A simple blow dry to remove frizz and seal in products and treatments.

categories.name: Hair Treatments, Wellness & ASMR Sensory Services

services.name: Luxury Shampoo & Scalp Tingles
services.description: Relaxing shampoo with scalp scratching and tracing.

services.name: Smoothing Blow Dry + Scalp Scratch Session
services.description: Luxury Shampoo & Scalp Tingles followed by a Blow Dry Style and hair/scalp play.

services.name: Scalp Detox & Tingle Ritual
services.description: Clarifying scalp cleansing treatment followed with sensory scalp stimulation. Great for dry or sensitive scalps and cleansing product build up.

services.name: Bleach Revival & Scalp Tingles
services.description: Refresh dried, tired, and bland bleached hair and restore balance with our blonde rejuvenation treatment. We clarify prelightened hair by removing build-up with a tingling clarifying treatment, follow up with a treatment for bleach processed hair, and finish with leave-in conditioning products designed for prelightened hair.

services.name: Luxury Conditioning & Scalp Tingles
services.description: A relaxing deep conditioning service with scalp tingle treatments tailored to your needs.

services.name: Hair Brushing ASMR Session
services.description: Slow brushing, tracing, and gentle hair play.

services.name: Aromatherapy
services.description: Choose your scent: Jasmine, Eucalyptus, Citrus, Peppermint, or Lavender.

services.name: Warm Towel Ritual
services.description: Soothing warm towel treatment to relax the scalp and neck.

services.name: Extended Tingle Services

categories.name: Body Waxing
categories.description: Nothing says self-care like body waxing. Whether it's underarms, legs, or brazilians — at Pink Moon we offer a calm setting to help you unwind and ease into our hair removal services.

services.name: Aura Healing
services.description: Using Reiki techniques, crystals, incense (and/or aromatherapy), as well as some light physical touch techniques — this service is for centering, relaxing, and channeling your spirit.

categories.name: Zodiac Readings
categories.description: All zodiac readings come with complimentary consulting customized per client.

services.name: Relationship Compatibility Reading
services.description: Discover how your chart aligns with a romantic partner or love interest. Explores crush compatibility, communication dynamics, and emotional compatibility to reveal what draws you together — and where you may need to grow.

services.name: Friendship / Family Compatibility Reading
services.description: Uncover the astrological patterns behind your closest bonds — from mother/daughter dynamics and sibling compatibility to friendship patterns and coworker communication. Understand why you connect effortlessly in some ways, and what you need to work on for deeper understanding.

services.name: Natal Chart Reading
services.description: Go beyond your Big 3 and discover more about the other planet and house placements to understand your own unique astrological makeup.

services.name: "Ask One Question" Zodiac Reading
services.description: Bring your most pressing question and receive a focused chart reading built around it. Great for clarity on things like: why you struggle in relationships, what career energy stands out in your chart, or why people tend to misunderstand you.

services.name: "Big 3" Mini Reading
services.description: A snapshot of your Sun, Moon, and Rising signs — your personality overview, emotional style, and outward image.

services.name: "Ask One Question" Tarot Reading
services.description: Whether you are curious about a question, you might be surprised by the answer. Draw up to two cards in a ten-minute reading.

services.name: Extended Tarot Reading
services.description: A deeper reading exploring themes, patterns, and guidance across multiple cards. Available in 30, 45, or 60-minute sessions.
